rules.clause: CGDCR Clause 19 - Structural Safety & IS 1893 compliance
rules.description: Continuous RCC plinth band and lintel band mandatory for all load-bearing masonry envelopes in Zone IV and V.
rules.remediation: Incorporate RCC tie-bands at plinth, lintel, and roof levels.
